summary: Depth-first rabbithole dossier for Embedding SDK; source-anchored research pack.

facts.text: [low] The MongoDB Atlas Charts Embedding SDK allows users to embed charts or dashboards into web applications, providing flexible adjustments for settings and rendering. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/embedding-charts-sdk.md

[low] Atlas Charts uses tokens passed with the Embedding SDK to authenticate users viewing embedded charts or dashboards that require authentication. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/configure-auth-providers.md
[low] The Embedding SDK supports authenticated chart and dashboard embedding with the realm-web SDK. Sources: https://github.com/mongodb-js/charts-embed-sdk/releases

[low] Users can install the Embedding SDK using `npm install @mongodb-js/charts-embed-dom` or `yarn add @mongodb-js/charts-embed-dom`. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/embedding-charts-sdk.md

[low] The preliminary embedding filter feature was released in package version 3.3.1, with the pre-filter feature planned for SDK release 3.3.0 after Atlas Charts 1.45. (verified as of 2026-10-15) Sources: https://github.com/mongodb-js/charts-embed-sdk/issues/90

[medium] Only users with the Project Owner role can configure embedding authentication providers or access the Authentication Settings page for a linked Charts instance. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/admin-settings.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/configure-auth-providers.md

[low] The UMD (Universal Module Definition) version of `@mongodb-js/charts-embed-sdk` allows running the SDK directly in the browser. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/charts/embedding-charts-sdk.md
